items.exampleEn: Milk is good for your bones.
My grandmother is eighty, but she is very healthy.
items.exampleZh: 我奶奶八十歲了，但很健康。

items.exampleEn: The medicine is in the box.
I exercise three times a week.
My knee hurts when I run.
My neck hurts from looking at my phone.
items.exampleZh: 一直看手機，我的脖子好痛。

items.exampleEn: I have a cold, and my nose is red.

items.sentenceEn: My neck and my knee hurt.
items.sentenceZh: 我的脖子和膝蓋都很痛。

items.audioEn: I exercise every morning, and I eat a lot of fruit.
items.audioZh: 我每天早上運動，而且吃很多水果。
items.questionZh: 說話者每天早上做什麼？

items.sentenceEn: Look at the dog's black nose.
My knee hurts after the game.

items.stemEn: The nurse puts the ____ on the table.
My grandpa is very ____. He walks for an hour every day.
items.stemZh: 我爺爺很健康，他每天走一個小時。

items.passageEn: Ann is seventy, but she is very healthy. She exercises every morning in the park. She drinks milk for her bones. Her sight is not good, so she wears glasses. Ann says, "Walking is good for me."
items.passageZh: Ann 七十歲了，但非常健康。她每天早上在公園運動，喝牛奶保養骨骼。她視力不好，所以戴眼鏡。Ann 說：「走路對我很好。」

referenceEn: Exercise is good for your health.
Exercising is very good for you.
rubricZh: 「運動」當主詞可用 exercise 或 exercising
「對⋯很好」用 good for（例如 good for your health、good for you）

items.instructionZh: 用 healthy 造一個句子，說說你怎麼保持健康，或誰很健康。
referenceEn: I eat vegetables to stay healthy.
rubricZh: healthy 是形容詞，放在 be 動詞後面或名詞前面（例如 is healthy、healthy food）
「保持健康」可用 stay healthy、keep healthy 等
